title: Treasury coupon announcement (month-end 2Y / 5Y / 7Y note + 2Y FRN reopening sizes)
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF, text layer decompressed and rebuilt from per-glyph Td/Tm coordinates direct 2026-09-05 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes, 909 glyph runs) — four separate rows carry the announcement date `Thursday, September 17, 2026`, each pairing it with an auction date the calendar already tracks independently: `2-Year FRN R` (auction Wednesday September 23, settlement Friday September 25), `2-Year NOTE` (auction Tuesday September 22), `5-Year NOTE` (auction Wednesday September 23) and `7-Year NOTE` (auction Thursday September 24). That agreement with four already-tracked auction dates is the corroboration — the announcement date is read from the same rows whose auction dates treasury-2y-note-2026-09-22, treasury-5y-note-2026-09-23 and treasury-7y-note-2026-09-24 already carry as `confirmed`. Bills are announced the same day and are not enumerated here; the PDF's three-month column interleave makes per-tenor bill attribution unreliable at this extraction quality, and no claim is made about which bill tenors land on this release. Stays estimate on two counts: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the announcement press release on 2026-09-17 itself
notes: The missing sibling in an announcement series the calendar already tracks five members of (2026-09-03, 2026-09-10, 2026-10-01, 2026-10-15, 2026-10-22), and specifically the confirming primary for treasury-2y-frn-2026-09-23, which is `estimate`-dated on a tentative schedule and has no dated event to attach its confirmation to — the exact gap the 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-10 entries were each created to close for their own blocks. Also already named, without a calendar row, by FT-treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-10-22-1 as its `free out-of-sample pre-check, 35 days early`: sb0590's Sep-26 row `69 58 70 44 39 13 22 28` sizes this block, so a miss here kills that test before October begins. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. One structural note for whoever researches it: this announcement lands the day after the 2026-09-16 FOMC decision and one day before the 2026-09-18 triple witching, and the 2-Year FRN it sizes has its index rate fixed by the 13-week bill auctioned Monday 2026-09-21 — i.e. after the decision, the mirror of the 2026-10-28 new issue whose index is locked two days before its own. Discovered and filed by the treasury-2y-frn-2026-09-23 initial research (2026-09-05).
